subject: Onsite pen test runbook, access timeline, and remediation checkpoints
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@olivesec.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Acme Security <security@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Upcoming onsite pen test - initial dates and scoping questions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for confirming OliveSec for the August window. We have tentative availability the week of Aug 24 for an on-site run (2 full days of active testing plus 1 day for interviews and evidence collection). Before we lock dates we need quick clarifications on scope items:

- Confirm list of externally-facing IPs and subdomains (Do you want external network testing limited to the public app gateways or include management endpoints?)
- Will we have a read-only jumpbox account for the auth team, and what is the OIDC/SSO provider (Okta, Azure AD, other)?
- Any systems to explicitly exclude (air-gapped infra, on-prem backups)?

Also attaching our standard scope template so your team can mark required additions.

Attachments: olive_pt_scope_v2.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

Let me know a good time today for a 20-min sync to finalize.

Cheers,
Raj Patel
Lead Engagement Manager, OliveSec Labs
scans@olivesec.com

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@olivesec.com>
Cc: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming onsite pen test - initial dates and scoping questions

Raj —

Thanks, appreciate the template. Quick answers below and we can run the 20-min sync at 3pm PT if that works for you.

- External scope: Please include public app gateways (api.redwood.ai, console.redwood.ai) and the customer-facing inference endpoints. Exclude internal management VPCs and our on-prem backup cluster.
- Jumpbox: Yes — we will provide a read-only jumpbox with ephemeral accounts scoped to the test hours. We'll also provide a list of rotation keys and contact for immediate lockout if needed.
- SSO: We use Okta for employee SSO; however Acme has its own SSO for their environment — you can assume Okta for Redwood access.

I attached the current asset inventory CSV and a short jumpbox instructions stub. Evelyn, Dylan — please confirm the jumpbox provisioning timeline so we can confirm dates with Raj. Marcus — FYI on the external endpoints list.

Attachments: redwood_asset_inventory.csv, jumpbox_instructions.txt

Best,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@olivesec.com>
Cc: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming onsite pen test - initial dates and scoping questions

Jonas / Raj —

We can have the jumpbox ready with ephemeral accounts by Aug 23 (provisioned by our IdP via Okta SAML just-in-time). Access modalities:

- SSH bastion with 2FA via Okta Verify (we'll provide one-time TOTP codes for each test user).
- SFTP access to a read-only evidence drop box for log pulls.
- We will maintain a lockout contact (pager) during active testing windows.

I'll send follow-up with the ephemeral user naming convention and a short runbook (how to request escalation). If you need VPN access instead let us know — that will require separate network ACL changes and a 48-hour lead time.

-Dylan
Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@olivesec.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Acme Security <security@acmecorp.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming onsite pen test - initial dates and scoping questions

Thanks Dylan — that flow works. One additional scoping request from our lead testers: can you include the SSO audit trail (Okta admin event logs) and the log retention pipeline for inference request logs (we typically review ingestion → storage → deletion TTL paths for potential data exposure)? We understand retention systems can be sensitive; if you prefer we can exclude the PII columns and perform only metadata-level review.

If you can grant read-only access to Okta system logs and the logging pipeline pseudonymized view by Aug 22, we'll keep the core 2-day on-site testing for Aug 24–25.

Also: we require a signed SOW amendment for scope v2 (minor fee for additional log review). I'll attach the DocuSign link this afternoon.

Best,
Raj

From: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@olivesec.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming onsite pen test - initial dates and scoping questions

Raj —

We can authorize read-only access to Okta admin logs scoped to the ‘Auth’ and ‘Admin’ event types and provide a pseudonymized export of the inference request pipeline (redaction applied to user identifiers and any PII fields). Our SOC/compliance team reviewed the request and is comfortable with the limited view provided — this will also help with our SOC 2 evidence package.

Timeline commitments:
- Aug 19: SOW amendment signed (DocuSign).
- Aug 22: Okta read-only export + logging pipeline pseudonymized view delivered to OliveSec SFTP drop.
- Aug 23: Jumpbox accounts provisioned and 1-hour validation window.
- Aug 24–25: Active on-site testing.
- Aug 27: Initial draft report delivery (v1).
- Sep 3: Final report delivery (post-remediation verification).

Remediation SLO: Redwood will respond to high severity findings with an acknowledgement within 24 hours and a remediation plan within 5 business days; verification timelines will be coordinated as part of the remediation_checklist.xlsx.

Attachments: remediation_checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Information Security
Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@olivesec.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming onsite pen test - initial dates and scoping questions

Quick note from Eng ops — we will snapshot the API gateway configs and enable audit logging retention export (7 day window) for the test. For any high/critical findings on auth flows we'll triage in SECOPS-342 and aim for hotfix deploys within 48 hours of validation.

I'll assign owners in the remediation spreadsheet and we'll keep the Doc link in the Jira ticket. Looking forward to the report and we'll be online for the Aug 23 validation.

-Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
